title: Steering Reasoning Models for Safety: O1/DeepSeek-Style Architectures

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Reasoning models are frontier deployments where internal reasoning steps may plan unsafe actions. Steering at intermediate reasoning steps addresses a critical safety gap. Maximum impact: inner monologue safety is one of the most important open problems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Open-source reasoning models with exposed chain-of-thought (like DeepSeek-R1) are available but large. Extracting concept vectors at intermediate reasoning steps requires understanding the reasoning architecture. Comparing reasoning-step vs. final-layer steering is technically demanding.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two steering targets to compare (reasoning steps vs. final layer) on one model. Focused question but requires understanding reasoning model internals and may involve multiple extraction points.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
